rationale: Positives: The agent correctly authenticated the user via name and zip, located the correct delivered order, checked product variants, and initiated an exchange matching the user’s selections. Negatives/Policy violations: (1) The agent performed an order-changing write (the exchange) without first explicitly restating the exact changes and obtaining the user’s confirmation to proceed; the policy requires explicit confirmation before any write. (2) After the user asked to change the request to only exchange the lamp (and later to return the bottle), the agent asserted that the exchange could not be changed or canceled and that a return was impossible—without consulting tools or citing any tool-supported limitation. These statements are unsupported and may be incorrect, violating the rule against inventing facts and the requirement to use tools to check feasibility. (3) The agent did not confirm payment details or disclose the exchange price difference shown by the tool, which undermines providing correct final information about charges. Overall, these issues mean the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
